slides: Welcome back, and now the advanced questions of this topic, general problems.

slides.say: Into this topic go all the problems that are not of one special type. Not motion, not percents, and not work. In those topics there's usually a formula that guides us. Here there isn't.
So we deal with each question by what's in it. Sometimes we build an equation, and sometimes we just understand what they want and calculate.

slides: And almost every question here also has a psychometric shortcut. A size estimate, plugging in numbers, or a small insight. Try each question yourself first, and then watch. I'll see you in the next video.
